description: Spatial world contract (hevi.world_contract, contract_version 1.0). All lengths in metres, positions [x, y, z], ground plane XZ, up axis Y. See docs/rules/world_contract.md for the normative prose.

anchors.description: Published named points for hero subjects; cameras reference anchors by id, never by raw coordinates.

facing_deg.description: Yaw in degrees, 0 = +X (east), increasing counter-clockwise seen from above (+Y).

formulas.description: Interface formulas shared by neighbouring zones. Exactly two evaluable kinds: piecewise_linear (points, linear interpolation, clamped outside) and polynomial (coeffs in ascending powers, Horner).

ground.description: The single agreed groundAt provider. kind=formula: h(x,z)=a*x+b*z+c. kind=grid: regular grid file (cell_size_m + file). kind=external: external heightfield file. No second height source may exist.

size.description: Full extent [dx, dy, dz] in metres; footprint is centre +- size/2 on XZ.

lighting.description: Global lighting timeline, read by every zone and effect. Keyframes sorted by t (hours 0..24); night_factor 0=full day, 1=full night.

rules.description: Exclusion / height rules over a region (rect x_min/x_max/z_min/z_max or circle cx/cz/radius). applies_to lists object categories, '*' means all.

time.description: Shot-local time convention: action time is relative to the shot (t=0 is the shot's first frame), never whole-film absolute time.

seed.description: World seed; all builders derive their RNG from this seed.

title: hevi world contract
